title: Mochizuki Honami — Aftermath Of Courage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good. We can play eight songs back to back without much of a problem, and we're performing each song pretty well...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. You've all improved so much since you first started practicing for your solo show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, your overall performance is coming along very nicely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It is?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
And we have you to thank, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's right. Thank you so much for asking Kohane and Kamishiro to help us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, all I did was ask them to help. You should be thanking them instead of me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, Miku, Luka, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me write the introduction for our band and giving me advice about our show!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As a result, we've been able to focus on practicing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It was our pleasure. I mean, we weren't about to leave our beloved juniors hanging.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right! And it was super fun because helping out with your show meant we got to be a part of it♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
I'm glad we were able to help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...
Did you figure out what you're gonna do about your stage outfits?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I vaguely remember you mentioning that you wanted to ask someone about that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Honami's mom helped us with that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?
Your mom made them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, no. Not from scratch. I just asked her to touch up our current outfits.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The ones you made for us, right, Hona?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how they turned out♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I'll be looking forward to seeing them as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Honami... I should've asked this sooner, but... did she get mad at you at all?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Why would she?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because you asked her to do this so suddenly. Wouldn't that interfere with her work?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
So, did she get mad?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
Actually, she was happy to accept.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes. How do I put it...?
She was happy that her daughter was asking her for help.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She was happy about that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she was. When I asked if she could lend us a hand...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She mentioned that she had been worried about how I hadn't talked to her about school much after I entered junior high school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She said she made an effort on several occasions to see how I was doing, but I just kept saying that everything was okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She sort of regretted not being able to help me back then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, she was very happy about being given an opportunity to do so this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She sounds like a wonderful mother...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, she is...
She even said, “It's okay to ask more of me.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You should be asking more of us, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're always nice to everyone, so you deserve to get patted on the back more often... Right, Rin?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Definitely!
Especially considering how hard you've been working for your show! We've gotta pamper you a whole lot!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uh... That's a big jump...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
C'mon, Hona, over here!
You deserve some love!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I'll feed you some snacks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? W-Wait...!
Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. What a lovely sandwich.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, since you're offering... Saki, Rin, if you two don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo! You got it, Hona!
This is our thanks for everything you've done for us until now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It feels like she's not the one being doted on...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... More like a mom playing house with her children...
